services.desc: What a great day on the water, couldn't ask for more action! I had the pleasure of taking Peter out for a half-day morning trip on Grapevine Lake with Rusty Hook Charters. We set out in the early morning from Meadowmere Lane in Southlake, TX, ready to make the most of the summer conditions. The weather was perfect for fishing, with clear skies throughout our time on the water. Grapevine Lake was looking prime for some serious angling, and I was excited to show Peter what this fantastic body of water had to offer. The charters are suitable for families, beginners, and experienced anglers, focusing on catching white bass with various fishing techniques.
